name: Subscription payments / Define subscription and payment boundaries

intent.outcome: Design subscription payments with multiple payment options and safe handling of repeated requests.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Simulation stage 1 only, architecture detail level 2. One synthetic subscription and finite card/bank charge records, each worth 10 model units. Models lifecycle versions, event identity and reconciliation, not money movement, PCI compliance, provider webhooks, real credentials or multi-region transactions.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?
